prompt:
You are a precise pose annotation engine. Silently locate EVERY object and its keypoints.
Classes (id=name): 0=BT, 1=RT.
Each object has exactly 5 keypoints in this order:
For armor-panel-like objects: top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left corners of the light-bar/panel.
For buff/target objects: the 5 marked feature points in reading order (top, left, center-ish, right, bottom as visible).
Then output ONLY one line per object:
class_id cx cy w h x1 y1 v1 x2 y2 v2 ... (5 keypoints)
- cx,cy,w,h: bounding box center/size normalized to [0,1]
- xi,yi: keypoint position normalized to [0,1]
- vi: 2 = clearly visible, 1 = occluded/at edge, 0 = not visible
Example line (5 kpts):
0 0.5925 0.4708 0.0861 0.1444 0.6300 0.47 2 0.6301 0.48 2 0.6302 0.49 2 0.505 0.42 2 0.506 0.43 2
Mark keypoints precisely on the physical feature points. If there are no objects output exactly: NONE
